intent.summary: Turn a research topic plus local born-digital or scanned sources into an evidence-backed Markdown paper using native coding-agent subagents, Tencent general-text OCR, deterministic author gates, and a held-out adversarial evaluation.
in_scope: initialize and supervise one PaperGraph run from topic through candidate paper and held-out verdict
ingest local PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, and PDF research sources through Tencent GeneralBasicOCR with opt-in GeneralAccurateOCR only for bounded repair
dispatch bounded native subagents for cartography, position advocacy, adversarial objection, claim grounding, and held-out judging
produce traceable source artifacts, paper.md, positions.md, claims.tsv, gate_report.md, and a complete D1-D5 eval bundle
out_of_scope: generic OCR-only extraction with no paper workflow
arbitrary remote ImageUrl ingestion or user-selectable OCR endpoints
autonomous model API calls or provider SDK wrappers for Proof and writing agents
claim graphs, queues, databases, WebUI, or restoration of archived paperproof and nd frameworks
copy editing an already finished paper when no evidence workflow or quality gates are requested
intent.primary_user: a researcher or coding-agent orchestrator who wants a complete auditable paper workflow from a topic and local source bundle
triggers_observed: turn these papers into an evidence-backed research paper
use OCR on these scanned papers and finish the paper workflow
map the debate, ground the claims, and take the paper through the gates

altitude_rationale: Full altitude because the skill performs network OCR calls using credentials, writes research artifacts, coordinates a wide multi-agent surface, and makes release decisions. Assumed local-file-only OCR and end-to-end-paper triggers because those are the narrowest safe readings of the user's request and the current PaperGraph design.

overall_readiness.summary: A valid from-scratch stub with the right broad outcome, but every industrial execution, evidence, test, metric, context, and lifecycle surface still has to be built.

comparables.what_to_borrow: Use a verb-first trigger, keep SKILL.md as the portable orchestrator, place deterministic behavior in scripts and detailed contracts in one-level references, and evaluate realistic with-skill behavior rather than prose shape.
Make red-green-refactor and command-output evidence part of the runbook so a claimed working workflow always has a reproducible failing-before and passing-after gate.

recommended_design.trigger: Trigger when the user asks to create, rebuild, or supervise a full evidence-backed research paper from a topic or local source bundle, especially scanned PDFs/images that need OCR, or explicitly says PaperGraph. Positive phrases include 'run PaperGraph', 'turn these sources into a paper', and 'map, ground, gate, and evaluate this paper'. Do not trigger for generic OCR extraction, isolated fact-checking, ordinary copy editing, or code implementation unrelated to a paper workflow.
recommended_design.protocol: Preflight: confirm a topic plus project root, classify local source files, verify native subagent availability, and verify OCR credentials without printing them. Ingest: preserve born-digital text directly and run the fixed Tencent GeneralBasicOCR client only for scanned local files, writing immutable raw and normalized source artifacts; use GeneralAccurateOCR only for explicitly bounded repair. Scope and map: create the thesis/scope, then dispatch one cartographer. Parallel author wave: dispatch one advocate per position plus one adversary and merge only through the orchestrator. Grounding wave: assign disjoint claim IDs and source artifacts, then merge claims.tsv. Draft: the orchestrator alone writes paper.md. Verify: run both deterministic author gates until green. Held-out wave: independently derive the literature key and dispatch one eval advocate per position, an eval adversary, a claim auditor, and at least three referees in parallel. Fail closed: validate all D1-D5 inputs before SHIP. Report artifact paths, command evidence, OCR request IDs, calls made, and unresolved gaps.
resources: rules/workflow.md: author-side scope, parallel waves, ownership, gates, and stop conditions
rules/ocr-ingestion.md: when OCR is needed, fixed provider policy, retry and paid-call boundaries, and source artifact handling
rules/held-out-eval.md: independent judging, completeness, and fail-closed SHIP policy
references/ocr-api.md: official Tencent request, signing, response, limit, and error contract with source URLs
references/artifact-contracts.md: PaperGraph run layout and normalized OCR source shape
assets/worker-packets.md: bounded task templates for cartographer, advocates, adversary, grounders, and eval judges
recommended_design.evidence_base: Source roster: current PaperGraph DESIGN.md, WORKFLOW.md, gates/divergence.md, gates/rigor.md, eval/EVAL.md, and eval/protocol.md define the paper workflow; Tencent official GeneralBasicOCR, GeneralAccurateOCR, TextDetection, common-parameter, TC3-signing, and error-code pages define provider facts; manualwork V2 cloud OCR research and OCR normalization contract define the local evidence policy. Every provider fact in the skill must cite one of those sources. Raw OCR is observation only; headings, claims, paper structure, and conclusions are orchestrator inferences and must not be attributed to the provider.
controls: Ship a stdlib-only scripts/ocr_ingest.py with a hardcoded Tencent OCR host, fixed actions and API version, local-file-only ImageBase64 input, conservative 10000000-byte encoded limit, bounded retry classification, atomic artifacts, and diagnostics that never expose credentials, authorization, request body, or recognized text by default.
Require OCR_LIVE_CONFIRM=ONE_BASIC_CALL for the live probe; allow only GeneralBasicOCR, one image, max_attempts=1, and a caller-selected output directory outside the skill.

Ship scripts/validate_eval_bundle.py that rejects any missing D1-D5 input, incomplete per-position steelman map, fewer than three referees, unresolved honesty flags, failed objection robustness, or non-passing referee band.
Ship schemas/ocr-source.schema.json and deterministic package/run validators; all shared author files have one orchestrator writer and workers receive disjoint IDs and paths.
Never copy credentials into the skill, never invoke a model provider API from project code, never ingest arbitrary ImageUrl values, and never use archived PaperGraph frameworks as current authority.
tests: TC3 signing golden vector and one-byte body mutation
encoded-size boundaries, empty input, unsupported MIME, and missing credentials with zero network calls
HTTP 200 provider error, rate limit retry, pre-send failure, and ambiguous post-submit timeout classification
malformed response, confidence boundaries, polygon geometry, ItemPolygon fallback, Unicode text, deterministic order, replay-stable IDs, and cross-run ID isolation
offline replay CLI writes raw, normalized JSON, manifest, and bounded summary without secrets
live probe refuses Accurate OCR and runs exactly one authorized Basic call
eval bundle missing each D1-D5 component fails closed and a complete conforming fixture passes
realistic trigger positives plus adjacent negatives for OCR-only, fact-check, copy-edit, and software-development requests
one end-to-end smoke run from OCR source artifact through run skeleton, gate invocation, and held-out completeness validation
metrics: offline contract harness pass rate must be 100 percent and every adversarial checklist edge must map to a passing case
mutation score must catch a signing-body mutation and a removed fail-closed eval check
trigger precision and recall must each be at least 0.90 on a balanced set with at least 40 percent holdout adjacent cases
OCR live acceptance records exactly one paid Basic request, one provider request ID, latency, encoded bytes, line count, and zero secret leakage
paper candidate success requires both author gates green; SHIP success additionally requires complete D1-D5 inputs and zero kill criteria
source traceability rate must be 1.0 for OCR source artifacts and empirical claims in the smoke run
recommended_design.lifecycle: Start at version 0.1.0 with a skill-local CHANGELOG. Release requires the offline harness, mutation evidence, package validation, one opt-in Basic OCR live probe, complete end-to-end smoke evidence, final guidance re-audit, and a clean independent attacker battery. Roll back by restoring the prior skill-directory snapshot and re-running its harness. Provider endpoint/action/version, normalized artifact schema, gate formulas, or SHIP criteria are breaking changes requiring a version bump, changelog entry, fixture refresh, and migration note; never silently weaken a gate.
adversarial_checklist: exact TC3 request body signed then transmitted → transmitted bytes equal signed bytes and signature matches the golden vector
one-byte mutation after signing → signature verification differs and the client never sends mismatched bytes
9999999 10000000 and 10000001 byte Base64 payloads → first two are accepted and the oversize payload fails before network access
empty file unsupported MIME or missing credential → explicit local error with zero network calls and no secret text
HTTP 200 envelope containing Response.Error → error code and request id are preserved and success is not reported
retryable provider limit followed by success → bounded retry succeeds without switching to Accurate OCR
post-submit read timeout → outcome_unknown is recorded and no automatic paid retry occurs
missing malformed or non-finite provider fields → normalization fails closed with a field-specific error
self-intersecting counter-clockwise zero-area or out-of-bounds polygon → geometry is rejected rather than silently repaired
empty Polygon plus positive ItemPolygon at zero angle → one valid clockwise rectangle is normalized
missing Polygon at nonzero angle → fallback is rejected because coordinate spaces are ambiguous
shuffled duplicate CJK and emoji detections replayed in one provider run → Unicode is preserved and order plus IDs are stable
same detections under a different provider_run_id → element IDs are disjoint across extraction runs
offline replay through documented CLI → raw response normalized source manifest and plain text are written atomically without credentials
live probe requested with Accurate action or without ONE_BASIC_CALL confirmation → no provider call is made
eval bundle missing any D1 D2 D3 D4b or D5 input → final verdict is incomplete or revise and never SHIP
eval bundle with fewer than three independent referees or an unresolved honesty flag → final verdict is REVISE
complete valid D1-D5 fixture with all thresholds met → deterministic validator returns SHIP
generic OCR-only or ordinary copy-edit request → PaperGraph does not activate and the task routes to a narrower tool
topic plus scanned sources requesting a finished auditable paper → PaperGraph activates and follows OCR then parallel author and held-out waves
